# GENESIS

## Role

`GENESIS` is a Bioconductor R package for genetic association testing, population
structure and relatedness inference. Its documentation includes admixture
mapping functions that use local-ancestry results such as RFMix output.

## Appropriate simitall Use

- Structure- and relatedness-aware association analysis in R.
- PC-AiR and relatedness-aware population-structure summaries.
- Admixture mapping after valid local-ancestry input has been created and
  converted to a supported genotype representation.

## Required Boundary

GENESIS does not infer local ancestry from raw unphased cohort genotypes. A
local-ancestry inference step and an appropriate reference panel are still
required before `admixMap()`-style analyses.

## References

- Official package page: https://bioconductor.org/packages/GENESIS/
- `admixMap()` documentation describes use with local-ancestry results such as
  RFMix output.
